analyst_view.overall: Bayern are unbeaten, joint top on 18 points and won 2-0 at Atlético on Tuesday, but Vincent Kompany is still absent after his collapse and hospital stay, so an assistant leads the team. Bayern are also short of attackers: Díaz, Gnabry, Musiala and Saibari are out. Mainz were beaten 4-1 at Elversberg, have lost four of their last five games in all competitions, have conceded 17 league goals in six, and are without the suspended Stefan Posch.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.7 goals. Mainz's defence is the leakiest in the league over the last six games (17 conceded, six inside the first 15 minutes) and Posch is suspended, which points up. Bayern, though, are without Díaz, Gnabry, Musiala and Saibari, and Olise took a knock against Dortmund, which points down. Overall we stay with the model.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. Bayern should dominate the ball as usual, and nothing in the news shifts the corner picture.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards. Mainz under pressure at home could get more physical, but there is no specific news on discipline beyond Posch's ban. Robert Schröder referees.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.7 shots. Bayern have the league's highest xG and most big chances, and Kane, with six goals in five league games against Mainz, is expected to start. Their attacking absences stop us going higher.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.7 shots on target. Mainz are conceding a lot of chances, but a weakened Bayern front line balances that out.
